passages.text: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits on many waters.
passages.sermon:
One of the seven angels came to me.
These seven angels each held a bowl.
The angel spoke to me.
He said, “Come with me.
I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute.
She sits on many waters.”
passages.original: Καὶ ἦλθεν εἷς ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλων τῶν ἐχόντων τὰς ἑπτὰ φιάλας καὶ ἐλάλησεν μετ’ ἐμοῦ λέγων Δεῦρο δείξω σοι τὸ κρίμα τῆς πόρνης τῆς μεγάλης τῆς καθημένης ἐπὶ ὑδάτων πολλῶν

passages.text: The kings of the earth were immoral with her, and those who dwell on the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her immorality.”
passages.sermon: The great prostitute sits on many waters.\r\nThe kings of the earth acted immorally with her.\r\nThe people who live on the earth became drunk from the wine of her immorality.
passages.original: μεθ’ ἧς ἐπόρνευσαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐμεθύσθησαν οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν γῆν ἐκ τοῦ οἴνου τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς

passages.text: And the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness, where I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.
passages.sermon:
An angel took me away.
The angel acted by the Spirit.
The angel brought me into a wilderness.
I saw a woman there.
The woman sat on a scarlet beast.
The beast was red like scarlet.
The beast was covered with blasphemous names.
The beast had seven heads.
The beast had ten horns.
passages.original: Καὶ ἀπήνεγκέν με εἰς ἔρημον ἐν Πνεύματι καὶ εἶδον γυναῖκα καθημένην ἐπὶ θηρίον κόκκινον γέμοντα ὀνόματα βλασφημίας ἔχων κεφαλὰς ἑπτὰ καὶ κέρατα δέκα

passages.text: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls. She held in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of her sexual immorality.
passages.sermon:
The woman wore purple and scarlet clothes.
She was adorned with gold.
She wore precious stones and pearls.
She held a golden cup in her hand.
The cup was full of abominations.
The cup contained the impurities of her sexual immorality.
passages.original: καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἦν περιβεβλημένη πορφυροῦν καὶ κόκκινον καὶ κεχρυσωμένη χρυσίῳ καὶ λίθῳ τιμίῳ καὶ μαργαρίταις ἔχουσα ποτήριον χρυσοῦν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτῆς γέμον βδελυγμάτων καὶ τὰ ἀκάθαρτα τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς

passages.text: And on her forehead a mysterious name was written: BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
passages.sermon:
The woman had a name written on her forehead.
The name was a mystery.
The name said, “Babylon the Great.”
The name also said, “The Mother of Prostitutes.”
The name also said, “The Mother of the Abominations of the Earth.”
passages.original: καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ μέτωπον αὐτῆς ὄνομα γεγραμμένον μυστήριον ΒΑΒΥΛΩΝ Η ΜΕΓΑΛΗ Η ΜΗΤΗΡ ΤΩΝ ΠΟΡΝΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΤΩΝ ΒΔΕΛΥΓΜΑΤΩΝ ΤΗΣ ΓΗΣ

passages.text: I could see that the woman was drunk with the blood of the saints and witnesses for Jesus. And I was utterly amazed at the sight of her.
passages.sermon:
The woman appeared before me.
She was drunk with the blood of the saints.
She was also drunk with the blood of those who witnessed for Jesus.
I saw her.
I was greatly amazed.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον τὴν γυναῖκα μεθύουσαν ἐκ τοῦ αἵματος τῶν ἁγίων καὶ ἐκ τοῦ αἵματος τῶν μαρτύρων Ἰησοῦ Καὶ ἐθαύμασα ἰδὼν αὐτὴν θαῦμα μέγα

passages.text: “Why are you so amazed?” said the angel. “I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
passages.sermon:
An angel spoke to me.
The angel asked me a question.
The angel said, “Why are you so amazed?”
The angel said he would explain something to me.
He said, “I will tell you the mystery of the woman.”
He also said, “I will tell you the mystery of the beast that carries her.”
This beast has seven heads.
This beast has ten horns.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὁ ἄγγελος Διὰ τί ἐθαύμασας ἐγὼ ἐρῶ σοι τὸ μυστήριον τῆς γυναικὸς καὶ τοῦ θηρίου τοῦ βαστάζοντος αὐτήν τοῦ ἔχοντος τὰς ἑπτὰ κεφαλὰς καὶ τὰ δέκα κέρατα

passages.text: The beast that you saw—it was, and now is no more, but is about to come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction. And those who dwell on the earth whose names were not written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see the beast that was, and is not, and yet will be.
passages.sermon:
The beast appeared in the vision.
The beast existed in the past.
The beast does not exist now.
The beast will soon come up from the Abyss.
The beast will go to destruction.
Many people live on the earth.
Their names are not written in the Book of Life.
The Book of Life was written from the foundation of the world.
These people will see the beast.
They will marvel at the beast.
They will see that the beast existed before.
They will see that the beast does not exist now.
They will see that the beast will appear again.
passages.original: Τὸ θηρίον ὃ εἶδες ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν καὶ μέλλει ἀναβαίνειν ἐκ τῆς ἀβύσσου καὶ εἰς ἀπώλειαν ὑπάγει καὶ θαυμασθήσονται οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὧν οὐ γέγραπται τὸ ὄνομα ἐπὶ τὸ βιβλίον τῆς ζωῆς ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου βλεπόντων τὸ θηρίον ὅτι ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν καὶ παρέσται

passages.text: This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
passages.sermon:
This message needs wisdom.
A wise mind can understand it.
The seven heads are seven mountains.
The woman sits on these seven mountains.
passages.original: Ὧδε ὁ νοῦς ὁ ἔχων σοφίαν αἱ ἑπτὰ κεφαλαὶ ἑπτὰ ὄρη εἰσίν ὅπου ἡ γυνὴ κάθηται ἐπ’ αὐτῶν

passages.text: There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come; but when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.
passages.sermon:
There are seven kings.
Five kings have fallen.
One king now exists.
Another king has not yet come.
When this other king comes, he must remain only a short time.
passages.original: καὶ βασιλεῖς ἑπτά εἰσιν οἱ πέντε ἔπεσαν ὁ εἷς ἔστιν ὁ ἄλλος οὔπω ἦλθεν καὶ ὅταν ἔλθῃ ὀλίγον αὐτὸν δεῖ μεῖναι

passages.text: The beast that was, and now is not, is an eighth king, who belongs to the other seven and is going into destruction.
passages.sermon:
The beast once existed.
The beast does not exist now.
The beast is an eighth king.
The beast comes from the seven kings.
The beast is going to destruction.
passages.original: Καὶ τὸ θηρίον ὃ ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν καὶ αὐτὸς ὄγδοός ἐστιν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἑπτά ἐστιν καὶ εἰς ἀπώλειαν ὑπάγει

passages.text: The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but will receive one hour of authority as kings, along with the beast.
passages.sermon:
The ten horns are ten kings.
These ten kings have not yet received a kingdom.
These ten kings will receive authority for one hour.
They will have authority as kings.
They will receive this authority together with the beast.
passages.original: καὶ τὰ δέκα κέρατα ἃ εἶδες δέκα βασιλεῖς εἰσιν οἵτινες βασιλείαν οὔπω ἔλαβον ἀλλὰ ἐξουσίαν ὡς βασιλεῖς μίαν ὥραν λαμβάνουσιν μετὰ τοῦ θηρίου

passages.text: These kings have one purpose: to yield their power and authority to the beast.
passages.sermon: These kings act together with one purpose.\r\nThey give their power to the beast.\r\nThey give their authority to the beast.
passages.original: οὗτοι μίαν γνώμην ἔχουσιν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν καὶ ἐξουσίαν αὐτῶν τῷ θηρίῳ διδόασιν

passages.text: They will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will triumph over them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and He will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones.”
passages.sermon:
The Lamb is Jesus Christ.
Jesus is Lord of lords.
Jesus is King of kings.
Ten kings will fight against Jesus.
These kings will join with the beast.
They will make war against Jesus.
Jesus will defeat them.
Jesus will have victory over them.
Jesus will not be alone.
His followers will be with Him.
His followers are called.
His followers are chosen.
His followers are faithful.
passages.original: Οὗτοι μετὰ τοῦ Ἀρνίου πολεμήσουσιν καὶ τὸ Ἀρνίον νικήσει αὐτούς ὅτι Κύριος κυρίων ἐστὶν καὶ Βασιλεὺς βασιλέων καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ κλητοὶ καὶ ἐκλεκτοὶ καὶ πιστοί

passages.text: Then the angel said to me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute was seated, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.
passages.sermon:
An angel spoke to me.
The angel explained the vision.
The angel said, “You saw waters.
The prostitute was sitting on these waters.
These waters mean people.
These waters mean large crowds.
These waters mean nations.
These waters mean languages.”
passages.original: Καὶ λέγει μοι Τὰ ὕδατα ἃ εἶδες οὗ ἡ πόρνη κάθηται λαοὶ καὶ ὄχλοι εἰσὶν καὶ ἔθνη καὶ γλῶσσαι

passages.text: And the ten horns and the beast that you saw will hate the prostitute. They will leave her desolate and naked, and will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
passages.sermon:
The ten horns are ten rulers.
The beast is a powerful enemy of God.
You saw the ten horns and the beast.
They will hate the prostitute.
They will make her desolate.
They will make her naked.
They will eat her flesh.
They will burn her with fire.
passages.original: καὶ τὰ δέκα κέρατα ἃ εἶδες καὶ τὸ θηρίον οὗτοι μισήσουσιν τὴν πόρνην καὶ ἠρημωμένην ποιήσουσιν αὐτὴν καὶ γυμνήν καὶ τὰς σάρκας αὐτῆς φάγονται καὶ αὐτὴν κατακαύσουσιν ἐν πυρί

passages.text: For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose by uniting to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
passages.sermon:
God acted first.
God put His purpose into their hearts.
God caused them to agree together.
They united in their decision.
They gave their kingdom to the beast.
They did this until God’s words were fulfilled.
passages.original: ὁ γὰρ Θεὸς ἔδωκεν εἰς τὰς καρδίας αὐτῶν ποιῆσαι τὴν γνώμην αὐτοῦ καὶ ποιῆσαι μίαν γνώμην καὶ δοῦναι τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτῶν τῷ θηρίῳ ἄχρι τελεσθήσονται οἱ λόγοι τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: And the woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.”
passages.sermon: The woman you saw is a city.\r\nThis city is very great.\r\nThis city rules over the kings of the earth.
passages.original: καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἣν εἶδες ἔστιν ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη ἡ ἔχουσα βασιλείαν ἐπὶ τῶν βασιλέων τῆς γῆς
